steps: disconnect during generation, refresh and recover the same task
new blank, missing information, refresh, supplement same task, summary and undo/redo
generated master, pointer selection and compound exact edit preserve every other field
full service restart keeps project, conversation and history
reopened conversation continues editing without regenerating
clarification project and history reopen after restart

limitations: Only one rectangular room per text task; no multi-room text generation, irregular outlines, photo generation or cloud deployment.
Initial furniture keeps catalogue dimensions; a shortage stops without a formal write.
Visual review can still disagree with code; code checks are the blocking gate and failures are retained.
GLB checks use rectangular footprints, not exact mesh collision; accessibility, lighting and regulations are out of scope.
